lines.text: Good evening. Suit diagnostics are green, and your heart rate is a little high. [chuckle] Nervous?
Would you like night vision, or should we keep pretending you can see in the dark? [laugh]
[sigh] You just webbed the pigeon again. That's the third one this week.
[gasp] Incoming at your three o'clock! Web shooters are ready whenever you are.
